verdict.rationale: Brex offers a documented MCP server and Transactions/Expenses APIs that let an agent read transactions and expense data (brex-docs-3, brex-docs-4, brex-docs-7), and Brex's own AI features (audit/review agents, policy flags on bookings) show categorization and policy-flagging happening natively (brex-docs-6, brex-docs-15, brex-docs-16, brex-docs-23). However there is no explicit documentation of an end-to-end 'pull uncoded transaction → propose category/policy flag → push clean coding back for human review' workflow exposed via API/MCP for third-party agents — the categorization/policy logic described is Brex's own internal AI agents, not a clearly documented external write-back API for coding proposals. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for writing back proposed transaction categorizations, a documented human-review/approval step for agent-proposed codings, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
